speaker: Merchant
notes: YOK-159. Speech-bubble lines for the shop, bubble-sized (12 words or fewer). Warm shopkeeper, quietly covetous of Ryo's moves; he is the Tanuki, so no line names him or the copy rule. On a second run the hunger should read plainly. Placeholders: {move} (copy target, T2); item_focused also uses {name} and {card_text}, which are new. Variant 0 of greeting_row4 is S3 verbatim. This file is a different kind from story_card and lives in data/story/shop/ so StoryLibrary (top-level *.json, throws on other kinds) does not load it; it needs the schema addition named in the ticket report.

greeting_row4.trigger: Row 4 merchant visit, before the heal-or-shop choice (S3)
variants: That {move} of yours... I'd love one.
Ah, Ryo! That {move} of yours... I'd love one. Only looking!
Back again! You've been busy. Your hands look well-practised.
Welcome, welcome. I've set out a fresh shelf for you.
You fight so beautifully now. Do show me again, sometime.

item_focused.trigger: A shelf item is hovered or focused: the bubble speaks a lead-in wrapping the item card text (designer decision, YOK-159)
modifier_tags: You choose which special wears it.
Pick the special that carries it.
item_focused.notes: {card_text} is only the plain-language line of the item card block (A12: frame data sits behind a toggle and is never spoken), taken from the card block from data/moves or data/modifiers, inserted verbatim (A12); lead-ins and tags never alter or paraphrase it. Order: lead-in (with card_text), then modifier tag, then unaffordable tag when they apply. Lead-ins at most 6 words excluding {card_text}; tags at most 6 words.

variants: Wonderful! Treat it kindly. Borrowed things always need it.
Sold! It will serve you well, while it lasts.
A new trick for the collection. I do love a collection.

bought_modifier.trigger: Ryo buys a modifier and attaches it to a special (R6, A2)
variants: A little polish on your move. Oh, it shines.
Clever! Even better than before. I'll remember it.
Sold! Watch that move now. Go on, I'll watch too.

cannot_afford.trigger: Ryo tries to buy with too few coins
variants: Ah, not quite enough coins. Win a few more, friend.
So close! Come back when your purse is heavier.
Fair is fair, I'm afraid. Even for you.

slot_full.trigger: Ryo tries to buy a special with every slot full; a replaced move loses its levels (A6)
variants: Hands full! Swap one out? It forgets everything, mind.
No room. Something must go, and its lessons with it.
You can't hold more. Pity. Choose carefully.

release_binding.trigger: Ryo pays 40 to release a binding (R6)
variants: Letting one go? Kind of you. Forty, if you please.
Off it drifts. A little sad, isn't it?
Free, then. I'd have kept it, but you're braver.

release_last_special.trigger: Ryo tries to release his last special (T5): the merchant refuses
variants: Not that one! It's all you have left.
Oh no, no. You'd be empty-handed. I won't allow it.
That one stays with you. Trust a shopkeeper.

shelf_empty.trigger: No items left on the shelf
variants: All gone! You've cleaned me out.
Nothing left but dust and good manners.
Empty shelves. Come back when the road has given you more.
Off you go. Do keep that move safe for me.
Safe road, Ryo. We'll surely meet again.
Goodbye, goodbye! Don't lose anything precious.
